selection: Eight named motivating failures where available, then deterministic round-robin by direct error code within each draft group,20 per group. Fixed before model outputs; development diagnostic, not a random accuracy sample.
policy: Strict original failure only. New partial forms always require a model correction; they are never accepted as compiler passes. Up to4 typed edits including logical-subtree replacement; shared first attempt then at most2 feedback/generic retries. No pooling control or previous methods.
